title: Compare Rates of Change Core Test
description: Compare slopes and rates of change across graphs, tables, equations, and contexts.

questions.questionText: Plan A changes by 6 units for every 8 steps. Plan B changes by -9 units for every 6 steps. Which statement is true?
options: Plan B has the greater rate of change
Plan A has the greater rate of change
The two rates are equal
Only the run should be compared
questions.correctAnswer: Plan A has the greater rate of change
questions.explanation: Compare rates by writing both as change in y divided by change in x, then compare the simplified values.
